Class.Label: Spellbook
Class.Hint: Where this class's spells are prepared from.
Class.ReadsHint: Class tags whose spellbooks this class can use, separated by commas. Blank uses the default shown.

Source.Title: Spellbook
Source.ClassHint: Class tag this book is written for. Blank: any class.
Source.Missing: That spell can no longer be found.
Source.OwnerHint: The character this belongs to. It is theirs for the class named under Class. Blank: whichever class has chosen it as its spellbook.
Source.BaseValueHint: What the book costs with no spells in it. Set by the GM. The item's price follows from this and its spells.

Tab.KnownUnder: {count} more can be learned at this level.
Tab.KnownOver: {count} more than this class can know at this level.
Tab.PreparedUnder: {count} more can be prepared at this level.
Tab.PreparedOver: {count} more prepared than this class can prepare at this level.

Book.Title: Spellbook: {book} ({actor})
Book.DropHint: Drop a spell here to add it.
Book.NoItems: No spellbook items. Create one in the inventory's Spellbooks section.
Book.NotCarried: {name} is not carried, so nothing can be prepared from it.
Book.NotOwn: Spells are prepared from {name}, this class's own spellbook.
Book.NoEligible: No class on this character can use this spellbook.
Book.OffList: Not on this class's spell list
Book.Uncastable: This class can't cast spells of this level yet.

Refused.Missing: That spell could not be found.
Refused.NotSpell: Only spells can be added to a spellbook.
Refused.Embedded: Add the spell from a compendium, not from a character.
Refused.NoRoom: That spell does not fit in the pages left.

Prep.Title: Prepare Spells: {book} ({actor})
Prep.Failed: Preparing spells failed. See the console.
Prep.Missing: {count} spells could no longer be found and were not prepared.
Prep.NoBook: No spellbook item is chosen for this class.
Prep.ProfileSkipped: {count} spells in the profile can no longer be picked and were left out.
Prep.FavoredEmpty: No favored spells yet. Drop spells here to add them.
Prep.OffList: {name} is not on this class's spell list.
Prep.Staged: Preparation set. It takes effect when the rest ends.
Prep.StageNote: Chosen now, applied when the rest ends.
Prep.StageNoteSet: A preparation is already set for the rest. Setting again replaces it.
Prep.PendingNote: A preparation is set for the next rest.
Prep.FillNote: Filling open slots. Spells already prepared can't be reduced or changed.
Prep.Granted: Granted by a feature. Prepared without a spellbook.
Prep.RestOnlyNote: Spells are prepared after a rest. A loadout can be planned and saved here, but not applied yet.

Rules.Label: Slots and substitution
Rules.Title: Spell Rules: {name}
Rules.Hint: Each rule names a group of special slots, or makes matching spells cost more.
Rules.Name: Name
Rules.SlotsHint: Special slots this rule gives at each spell level.
Rules.KnownHint: For classes that prepare each spell once: extra spells per level that must fit this rule.
Rules.CostHint: Slots a matching spell takes when prepared in an ordinary slot.
Rules.Granted: Filled by domain or school spells on the character
Rules.GrantedHint: Takes the spells this feature grants. If it grants none, takes the ones other features grant.
Rules.DescriptorTextHint: Text a descriptor must contain, for descriptors not in the list.
Rules.FlexibleHint: The slot is left open, and any of these spells can be cast from it.

Sub.Cast: Cast by giving up a prepared spell
Sub.Title: Cast {name}
Sub.Body: Choose a prepared spell to give up for {name}.
Sub.None: No prepared spell can be given up to cast {name}.
Sub.RulesHint: Spells that can be cast by giving up a different prepared spell.
Sub.SacrificeDomain: Domain and school spells may be given up

Kind.Label: Spells
Kind.Domain: Domain or school spells on the character
Kind.Name: Spells whose name contains

Flex.Name: Flexible slot
Flex.Cast: Cast a spell from this slot
Flex.Body: Choose the spell to cast from {name}.
Flex.None: No spells can be cast from {name}.

Meta.Title: Metamagic
Meta.Label: Name before the spell
Meta.LabelHint: Goes in front of the spell's name, such as Empowered.
Meta.VariableHint: The caster picks how many levels to add, as with Heighten Spell.
Meta.HeightenHint: The spell's own level rises with its slot, so its save DC does too.
Meta.TooHigh: That raises the spell above 9th level.
Meta.ScriptHint: What it does to the spell is a Metamagic script call on this feat.
Meta.ScriptInfo: Runs when this metamagic is applied to a spell. Changes the spell's data through spell, levels, spontaneous, and meta.
Meta.ScriptFailed: {name}: its metamagic script failed. The spell was changed without it.

Borrow.Memory: Prepared from memory, with no spellbook
Borrow.Empty: No spellbook or remembered spell to prepare from.
Borrow.ConfirmBody: These spells are from a borrowed spellbook and have not been checked yet. Each takes a Spellcraft check, rolled one at a time. A failed spell is left out.
Borrow.Failed: The Spellcraft check failed. It can't be prepared from {book} until its checks are reset.
Borrow.FailedNow: {spell}: the check failed. It can't be prepared from {book} until its checks are reset.
Borrow.NotYours: This spellbook belongs to {owner}. Each spell takes a Spellcraft check to prepare from it.
Borrow.NotYoursUnnamed: This is not this class's own spellbook. Each spell takes a Spellcraft check to prepare from it.
Borrow.CheckNone: Not checked yet. Click to mark as passed.
Borrow.CheckFail: Check failed. Click to mark as passed.
Borrow.ResetHint: Clears every passed and failed check on this spellbook.
Borrow.Check: Roll Spellcraft, DC {dc}, to prepare this from {book}.
Borrow.CheckFirst: Roll the Spellcraft check for {spell} first.

Known.Label: Known spells
Known.Note: Spells this class knows. Spells written in its own spellbooks are added here, and stay when a spellbook is lost. A borrowed spellbook can only be used for these.
Known.Unknown: Not a spell this class knows, so it can't be prepared from {book}.
Known.UnknownHere: Not a spell this class knows. It can't be prepared from this spellbook.
Known.Written: Written in {book}, so it stays known.
Known.StillWritten: {spell} is still written in {book}, so it stays known. Remove it from that spellbook first.

Rest.Card: {name} has rested. Choose the day's spells:
Rest.NotOwner: Only the character's owner can prepare its spells.

RestOnly.Name: Prepare spells only after a rest
RestOnly.Hint: Apply in the Prepare Spells window works only once a rest has offered it: from the chat card after resting, or through a rest manager. Loadouts can still be planned and saved at any time. A GM can always apply.
